edges.reason: msg.sender is the deployer whose reflection balance is initialized in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the from-address for public transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender for allowance deduction in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
collectToken authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _devAddress.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine before adjusting allowance.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply the value transfer.
_transfer may invoke swapTokensForEth (external swap) before finishing its own state changes.
_transfer may invoke sendETHToFee (ETH transfers) before completing accounting.
collectToken performs an external swap of the full contract balance.
collectToken forwards the resulting ETH balance to fee recipients.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard for the actual accounting.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
swapTokensForEth triggers the router swap external call.
startTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the router.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the dev address, invoking its receive/fallback.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the owner address, invoking its receive/fallback.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router state variable to perform the swap.
startTrading writes and uses the uniswapV2Router state variable.
sendETHToFee reads _devAddress as transfer recipient.
sendETHToFee reads _ownerAddress as transfer recipient.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount state variable.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee application.
External router swap can re-enter the contract through the payable receive hook.
Re-entry after the external swap can re-invoke collectToken while balances are being updated.
Re-entrant call during the swap can re-enter _transfer and duplicate fee accounting.
addLiquidityETH payable call could route value back into the contract receive hook.
ETH transfer to the dev address can trigger a fallback calling back into the contract.
ETH transfer to the owner address can trigger a fallback calling back into the contract.
tokenAmount parameter supplies the swap input size.
amount parameter determines the ETH split between dev and owner.
maxTxPercent parameter drives the new transaction limit computation.
from parameter drives zero-address checks and reflection debit.
to parameter drives zero-address checks and reflection credit.
amount parameter is checked against _maxTxAmount.
takeFee local flag controls whether fees are removed.
contractTokenBalance local is computed and forwarded to the swap.
rAmount local is subtracted from the sender reflection balance.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a transient argument that only exists to feed the _transfer logic.
to is a transient argument consumed only by _transfer.
amount is an input consumed only by _transfer.
takeFee is a temporary flag computed and used only inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary balance snapshot used only inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is a transient argument of the swap routine.
amount_fee is a transient argument of the ETH distribution routine.
maxTxPercent is a transient argument used only by the setter.
sender is a transient argument consumed only by transferFrom.
recipient is a transient argument consumed only by transferFrom.
amount_tf is a transient argument consumed only by transferFrom.
sender_std is a transient argument consumed only by _transferStandard.
tAmount is a transient argument consumed only by _transferStandard.
rAmount is a temporary derived value used only by _transferStandard.
